ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominate >90% of the visible fluke surface. High-intensity (white/light grey) pixels are restricted to small localized clusters at the distal tips and along the trailing edge, and specular highlights from water surface reflectance.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation mapping across the entire surface. Distinct high-contrast white clusters located at the extreme left distal tip and along the upper-right trailing edge. Specular white highlights present on the central horizontal axis of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees at the visible convergence point; lower vertex is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular valleys, specifically a prominent 'stepped' indentation approximately midway between the notch and the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected at the far left distal tip and scattered sparsely on the right lobe surface near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, white linear pixel disruption (scratch) is visible on the lower-medial section of the left lobe, oriented at a roughly 45-degree diagonal.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation/loss of tissue on the right lobe trailing edge, creating a jagged profile distinct from standard serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: White water spray occluding the point of insertion and the lower portion of the median notch.
